# Preface {.unnumbered}

Welcome! In these pages you will find tutorial materials for the PPLE Skills and Research Methods for Psychology tutorials. In session 2025/26, we will be working with JASP [@JASP2025] which can be downloaded [here](https://jasp-stats.org/download/) or which can be accessed via connection to an [UvA virtual desktop](apps.uva.nl). 

Every tutorial page features video demonstrations which are often based on examples presented in the course textbook, _Discovering Statistics using JASP_ [@field2025], and the accompanying datasets prepared by Andy Field. All of these datasets can be downloaded directly from the textbook's [companion website](https://discoverjasp.com/pages/data).

Although not part of the course this year, code to run the featured analyses in the R programming language [@baseR] will also be included, for the curious.

For questions, please [get in touch](mailto:d.fleming@uva.nl)!
